label: economist at
definition: Person X is an economist affiliated with organization Y.
scope_notes: Economist-at/for/with/of dominates the occupational component. Generic official, diplomat, analyst, executive or specialist roles alone do not establish economist status. Departmental affiliation and historical service qualify.

facts.reason: David H. Resler is explicitly economist at and for Nomura Securities International.
Andrew Zimbalist is explicitly a Smith College economist and an economist teaching there; professor is an additional role.
Patrick C. Jackman is explicitly Labor Department economist, including department branch/unit affiliation; official, supervisor and branch-chief roles are additional.
Yasushi Akashi is a United Nations official, diplomat and envoy; none establishes an economist role.
Jared Bernstein is explicitly economist at, with and for the Economic Policy Institute; researcher and study co-author are additional roles.
